operational_question: Does this preserve the theological integrity that the named historical figure articulated?
failure_mode: Drift, soft paraphrase, reduction of the figure to a slogan; using the rule without attribution.

source.garden: theo-techno-cosmo/THE COUNCILE/Aristotle (384-322 BCE) GNOSIS EVENT EXTRACTION.txt

rules.name: All men by nature desire to know
rules.description: All men by nature desire to know — sight most of all; art arises when many experiences yield one universal judgement.

three_domain_reading.theology: Wonder leading toward first causes (later same book).
three_domain_reading.technology: Art as universal judgment from many cases.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Human kind distinct by connected experience and reason.

rules.name: Being said in many senses
rules.description: Being is said in many senses, related to one central point — substance — not by mere ambiguity.

three_domain_reading.theology: First philosophy of highest causes; God among causes (I.2 arc).
three_domain_reading.technology: Focal meaning as non-taxonomic unity of science.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: All that is depends on and is named from the primary (substance).

rules.name: Four causes
rules.description: Cause is said as matter, form, source of change, and end — several causes of the same thing, not in the same way.

three_domain_reading.theology: End and good as cause (that for the sake of which).
three_domain_reading.technology: Production knowledge: matter, form, agent, function.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Natural and artificial change under the same fourfold.

rules.name: Soul is first actuality
rules.description: Soul is the first actuality of a natural organized body — as meaningless to ask if soul and body are one as wax and stamp.

three_domain_reading.theology: Living form without dualist ghost-story as default.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Life as self-nutrition and growth in natural bodies.

rules.name: Every art aims at some good
rules.description: Every art and inquiry aims at some good — the chief good is desired for its own sake; politics is the master art.

three_domain_reading.theology: Good as that at which all aim.
three_domain_reading.technology: Hierarchy of arts under master arts.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Human life as ordered to a chief end.

rules.name: Activity of soul in accordance with virtue
rules.description: Human good is activity of soul in accordance with virtue — in a complete life; one swallow does not make a summer.

three_domain_reading.theology: Blessed life under excellence of the rational soul.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Human species defined by rational activity in time.

rules.name: Virtue is a mean
rules.description: Virtue is a state of choice lying in a mean relative to us — determined as the man of practical wisdom would determine it.

three_domain_reading.theology: Best and right as extreme of excellence though mean in substance.
three_domain_reading.technology: Habituation and choice as formation of character-state.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Passions and actions ordered between excess and defect.

rules.name: Man is by nature a political animal
rules.description: Man is by nature a political animal — speech sets forth the just and unjust; the state is prior to the isolated individual.

three_domain_reading.theology: Nature makes nothing in vain — speech for justice.
three_domain_reading.technology: Polis as association of beings with sense of good and evil.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Whole prior to part; state creation of nature.

rules.name: Something which moves without being moved
rules.description: Something moves without being moved — eternal, substance, actuality; the final cause moves as being loved; on such a principle depend the heavens.

three_domain_reading.theology: First principle good of necessity; thought of the best.
three_domain_reading.technology: Final cause among unchangeables as that at which action aims.
three_domain_reading.cosmology: Heavens and nature depend on the unmoved mover.
